query: Create a new universal skill for daily standup notes from these meeting transcripts.
expected_behavior: Creates a properly named skill folder in 04_skills/universal/
SKILL.md has valid YAML frontmatter (name, description)
Description is third-person and includes 'Use when' trigger language
Bulk transcript content goes to reference/, not SKILL.md
Build output script provided (e.g. build-the-file pattern)
failure_signs: Pastes raw notes into SKILL.md body verbatim
Output is >500 lines without splitting to reference/
